frozen_rule.question: Ink FDV above $500M one day after launch?
frozen_rule.literal_criteria: Yes if Ink token fully diluted valuation is greater than $500M one day after launch; token must be actively, publicly transferable and tradable. One day after launch = 4:00 PM ET on the calendar day following launch. Resolution source: most liquid price source available. If no token launch by 2026-12-31 11:59 PM ET, resolves No.
